name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success Operations & CRM Platform Administration
summary: Customer success operations practitioner and CRM platform administrator with 5+ years configuring customer lifecycle systems and 15+ years in SaaS, MarTech, and agency environments. Built and administers a 20+ workflow automation system spanning lead capture, routing, qualification, onboarding nurture, reactivation, and automated review-generation sequences, plus the reporting layer on top of it. Maps digital touchpoints across the customer journey, enforces data hygiene, and trains teams and clients on the platforms they run every day.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architected and deployed a complete marketing-automation system of 20+ workflows spanning lead capture, tagging and routing, qualification, appointment booking with confirmation and reminders, no-show recovery, post-sale onboarding nurture, long-term nurture and reactivation, and automated review-generation sequences.
Architect and implement CRM systems in GoHighLevel (primary) and HubSpot, covering contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, lead routing, and strict data-hygiene protocols.
Design and deploy automated lifecycle sequences, onboarding workflows, and CRM architectures that activate, nurture, and retain high-value users at scale.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to executive leadership.
Design self-improving loops and evaluation frameworks to monitor automated outputs and continuously optimize conversion rates.
Lead end-to-end onboarding for new technology stacks, translating business requirements into technical configurations and providing hands-on training.
Analyze complex marketing and operational datasets, extracting actionable insights and structured recommendations that improve performance.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping project records auditable across concurrent engagements.

Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.
